title: 第7章 天赋超等第8章 受伤的为什么都是我
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: “豪门大族哪家没有一些腌渍事，这有什么好奇怪，别说他一个私生子了，即使是嫡子，若是没有天赋，同样也好不到哪里去。”
“不过，这万尘的确是惨，身体那么弱，若是还不能修炼，恐怕也活不了几年了。”
“呵呵，这万尘想要拜入清风宗，简直是痴人做梦，刚才万家嫡子都没有拜成功，更何况他一个废人。”
万尘在清风城绝对是一个名人，当然他的出名绝对不是因为他的天赋，而是因为他特殊的身份。
万家在清风城是四大家族之一，实力雄厚，现任家主也非常重视培养下一代，希望在年轻一代能培养出一位先天高手，即使出不了先天，也希望能进入宗门高层。
所以万家主非常重视下一代，大量资源培养，就算是私生子的万尘，他也没有放弃。但是，万尘天生废体，资源再多对他也没有用，最后只能放弃，从此不管不问，最多每年见上一两次面。
对于一个家族来说，不能修炼意味着什么，所有人都知道，所以也没有人骂万家绝情。这要是放在自己家族里，他们也会这样做的。
不过，万尘想要拜入清风宗，却是出乎众人意料之外。
而之前被淘汰的万家嫡子万龙，此时已经拜入擎天宗，听到消息，怒火膨胀的带着几个万家子弟走了过来。
“你来做什么？”万龙怒气冲天地质问道。
“大哥，我想拜入清风宗。”万尘语气平静地问道，看不出喜怒。
“连我都被淘汰，你身体什么样的状况，你又不会不知道，你过来是想将我万家的脸都给丢光吗？”万龙嘲讽道。
万尘是私生子，而且又没有什么天赋，对于万龙的地位没有丝毫威胁，但是万龙就是看万尘不顺眼，如果不出现在自己眼前，他也不会故意找万尘的麻烦，但是偏偏万尘出来丢万家的脸，他自然不会放任。
“秦宗主刚才说了，只看资质，不看修为。兄长，小弟体质一直非常特殊，或许非同凡响，所以过来试一试。”万尘说道。
其实，万尘只是过来碰碰机会的。本来，他都已经绝望了，但是当他从下人处听到今天清风宗的事，就想过来碰碰运气。
“你！”万尘怒气冲冲地说道：“好！你就尽管来试吧！这么多天才都不够格拜入清风宗，而你这么一个废物，我就不信你能成功。”
“秦宗主，请检查我的资质。”万尘向秦叶恭敬行礼道。
秦叶打量着万尘，这个万尘长的其实蛮俊俏的，如果再有点修炼天赋，再加上其家世，妥妥地受城中万千女子追捧。只是可惜，在这个世界武者为尊，一个不能修炼的废物，即使脸庞再怎么好看，也不会有什么女子喜欢。
抛开其他不谈，秦叶还是蛮欣赏万尘的，只是不知道这万尘的资质怎么样，不过从小就不能修炼，想来资质也不会太高。
所以，秦叶也没有对他抱太大的希望。
“系统，检测万尘的资质。”秦叶心中对系统说道。
“叮，万尘：资质超等！建议宿主收下此人做弟子。”
秦叶脸色微微一变，不敢置信地看着万尘。在这样一个小地方，怎么可能有资质超等的人，像这样的人不敢说独断万古，但是至少能无敌一世。
“系统你不会搞错吧？”秦叶将信将疑地问道。
“请宿主不要质疑系统，本系统是不会检测错误的，万尘体质特殊，一旦觉醒，天赋才会是超等。”
content_en:
"Isn't it strange that any wealthy family doesn't have some pickling issues? Let alone an illegitimate son. Even if he is a legitimate son, if he has no talent, he will not be much better."
"However, Wan Chen is indeed miserable. His body is so weak. If he still can't practice, he probably won't live for a few more years."
"Haha, this Wan Chen wants to join the Qingfeng Sect. It's just a fool's dream. Just now, even the legitimate son of the Wan family failed to succeed, let alone he is a useless person."
…
Wan Chen is definitely a celebrity in Qingfeng City. Of course, his fame is definitely not because of his talent, but because of his special status.
The Wan family is one of the four major families in Qingfeng City, with strong strength. The current head of the family also attaches great importance to cultivating the next generation. He hopes to cultivate an innate master in the younger generation. Even if he cannot become an innate master, he hopes to enter the upper echelons of the sect.
Therefore, the head of the Wan family attaches great importance to the next generation and devotes a lot of resources to cultivating it. Even if Wan Chen is an illegitimate child, he will not give up. However, Wan Chen was born with a useless body, and no matter how many resources he had, it was of no use to him. In the end, he had to give up and ignore him from now on. He would only meet once or twice a year at most.
For a family, everyone knows what it means to be unable to practice, so no one scolds the Wan family for being heartless. If this were in their own family, they would do the same.
However, Wan Chen's desire to join the Qingfeng Sect was beyond everyone's expectations.
Wan Long, the legitimate son of the Wan family who was eliminated before, had already joined the Qingtian Sect. When he heard the news, he came over with several Wan family disciples in anger.
"What are you doing here?" Wan Long asked angrily.
"Brother, I want to join the Qingfeng Sect." Wan Chen asked in a calm tone, showing no emotion or anger.
"Even I was eliminated. You don't know what kind of condition you are in. Are you here to embarrass my Wan family?" Wan Long mocked.
Wan Chen is an illegitimate son and has no talent, so he does not pose any threat to Wan Long's status. However, Wan Long just dislikes Wan Chen. If it does not appear in front of him, he will not deliberately cause trouble for Wan Chen. But Wan Chen comes out to embarrass the Wan family, so he will not let it go.
"Sect Master Qin just said that we only look at aptitude, not cultivation. Brother, my physique has always been very special, perhaps extraordinary, so come here and give it a try." Wan Chen said.
In fact, Wan Chen just came here to take a chance. Originally, he was already in despair, but when he heard from his servants what happened in the Qingfeng Sect today, he wanted to come over and try his luck.
"You!" Wan Chen said angrily, "Okay! Just try it! There are so many geniuses who are not qualified to join the Qingfeng Sect, and you are such a waste, I don't believe you can succeed."
"Sect Master Qin, please check my qualifications." Wan Chen saluted Qin Ye respectfully.
Qin Ye looked at Wan Chen. This Wan Chen was actually quite handsome. If he had some cultivation talent and his family background, he would be sought after by thousands of women in the city. It's just a pity that in this world, warriors are respected, and no woman will like a useless person who cannot cultivate, no matter how beautiful his face is.
Putting aside everything else, Qin Ye still admires Wan Chen, but he doesn't know what Wan Chen's qualifications are, but he hasn't been able to practice since he was a child, so he doesn't think his qualifications are too high.
Therefore, Qin Ye didn't have much hope for him.
"System, test Wanchen's qualifications." Qin Ye said to the system in his heart.
"Ding, Wan Chen: Super qualified! I suggest the host accept this person as his disciple."
Qin Ye's face changed slightly and he looked at Wan Chen in disbelief. How could there be someone with super qualifications in such a small place? People like this wouldn't dare say they would be dictatorial for eternity, but they would at least be invincible for a lifetime.
"You can't make a mistake in the system, right?" Qin Ye asked doubtfully.
"Host, please don't question the system. This system will not detect errors. Wanchen's physique is special. Once he awakens, his talent will be super."
